name: Ew, I Stepped In Shit
core: Someone checks their shoe in disgust, and the sole shows the gross thing they 'stepped in'.
slots: the gross thing on the sole
avoid: Not for things the speaker actually likes or admires.

name: Spongebob Yelling
core: Spongebob screams in front of a stunned crowd, for an over-the-top outburst nobody asked for.
avoid: Not for quiet or polite reactions.

name: Unicorn Man
core: A buff man dressed as a glittery unicorn with a teacup, for proudly fabulous or absurdly over-the-top behavior.
avoid: Not for mocking anyone's identity or for serious topics.

name: Fake Gandhi Quote
core: A silly or modern line passed off as a profound quote, already signed '-Mahatma Gandhi'.
avoid: Not for genuine Gandhi quotes or mocking his real cause.

name: Consuela
core: A polite but firm 'no, no, no' refusal to a request, in Consuela's sing-song style.
avoid: Not for agreeing or for mocking accents or nationalities.

name: Michael Jackson Popcorn
core: Gleefully eating popcorn while watching drama or an argument unfold.
avoid: Not for being personally involved in the conflict.

name: Overwatch Mercy
core: Someone in trouble looks up in awe as a glowing hero arrives to save them.
avoid: Not for disappointments or villains.

name: But It Was Me, Dio
core: A smug twist reveal: you expected one thing, but it was me all along.
avoid: Not for sincere confessions or no-twist statements.

name: Am I A Joke To You
core: A neglected thing, ignored in favor of something else, asks indignantly 'Am I a joke to you?'.
aliases: Am I A Joke To You
Am I a joke to you guy
avoid: Not for things that are actually being used or appreciated.

name: First Day On The Internet Kid
core: A newbie excitedly does something naive that any veteran would know better than to do.
aliases: First Day On The Internet Kid
avoid: Not for experts or genuinely clever moves.

name: CNN Breaking News
core: A fake breaking-news chyron that treats something trivial as major headline news.
avoid: Not for real news, misinformation, or anything that could pass as a genuine broadcast.

name: Peter Griffin Running Away
core: Peter flees in panic from a plane chasing him, for running away from a looming responsibility or threat.
avoid: Not for calmly facing problems or happy chases.

name: Hey Girl Ryan Gosling
core: A smooth 'Hey girl' pickup line that turns out to be about something nerdy or mundane.
avoid: Not for creepy or explicit pickup lines.

name: Red Pill Blue Pill
core: Choose between a harsh truth (red pill) and a comfortable illusion (blue pill).
avoid: Not for political 'red pill' ideology or choices with no truth-vs-comfort angle.

name: Lonely Pablo Escobar
core: Pablo Escobar waiting alone and bored across three scenes, for endlessly waiting on something that never comes.
avoid: Not for glorifying the real cartel or for exciting, busy moments.

name: Spiderman Hospital
core: Spider-Man in a hospital bed, for ending up hurt or sick through your own silly choices.
avoid: Not for real illness or serious injuries.

name: Wojak Smiling Mask
core: A crying Wojak hides behind a smiley mask, for pretending everything is fine while falling apart inside.
avoid: Not for genuine happiness or serious mental health crises.

name: Khan
core: Kirk's anguished 'KHAAAN!' scream, for rage at someone who wronged you.
avoid: Not for mild annoyance or happy news.

name: Leave Britney Alone
core: A tearful, over-the-top plea to stop criticizing something you love: 'Leave X alone!'.
avoid: Not for mocking the person in the video or real distress.

name: Smilin Biden
core: A grinning, finger-pointing 'you got it, buddy' approval of someone's cheeky move.
avoid: Not for political attacks or partisan messaging.

name: Money Money
core: The Mask gleefully fanning wads of cash, for feeling rich or excited about money.
avoid: Not for real financial advice or money troubles.

name: Chubby Bubbles Girl
core: A little girl running eagerly toward something, for rushing excitedly at a thing you want.
avoid: Not for mocking the child's appearance.

name: Ron Burgundy
core: The pompous anchorman announces something trivial with total seriousness.
aliases: I'm kind of a big deal
avoid: Not for real news or serious announcements.

name: Impossibru Guy
core: A grimacing face of total disbelief that something could possibly happen: 'Impossibru!'.
avoid: Not for mocking accents or ethnicity; it's about disbelief.

name: Gravestone
core: A blank headstone for a mock epitaph mourning something that has died or been abandoned.
avoid: Not for real deaths or memorials.

name: Society If
core: A gleaming utopian city captioned 'Society if...' to claim one small change would perfect the world.
avoid: Not for real political manifestos.

name: Evil Cows
core: Two cows stand calmly in front of a raging fire, as if they caused the chaos and have no regrets.
avoid: Not for real wildfires or disasters.

name: Pepe Silvia
core: Charlie frantically explains a wild conspiracy board, for over-explaining a convoluted theory.
avoid: Not for real conspiracy theories or clear, simple explanations.

name: Pointing Mirror Guy
core: A man points at his own reflection, for blaming or calling out yourself.
avoid: Not for blaming other people.

name: Always You Three
core: McGonagall asks why it's always you three whenever something goes wrong, labeling the three usual culprits.
aliases: Why is it always you three
avoid: Not for a single culprit or for praise.

name: PTSD Chihuahua
core: A wide-eyed chihuahua with war flashbacks, for being triggered by a reminder of a past ordeal.
avoid: Not for real trauma or veterans' experiences.

name: Shrek For Five Minutes
core: Shrek asks for five minutes of peace, then glares with laser eyes at Donkey who interrupts anyway.
avoid: Not for welcome interruptions or happy surprises.

name: Dog Vs Werewolf
core: A friendly golden retriever next to a snarling werewolf: the same thing in its harmless form versus its terrifying form.
avoid: Not for two unrelated things; both must be versions of the same thing.

name: Happy Dolphin Rainbow
core: An over-the-top cheesy paradise of dolphins and rainbows, used to show pure bliss or how something feels in your imagination.
avoid: Not for genuinely sad or angry moments.

name: For Christmas I Want A Dragon
core: Told to be realistic, the kid names a 'realistic' wish so impossible that Santa would rather grant the dragon.
aliases: what color do you want your dragon
avoid: Not for wishes that are actually achievable.

name: Nuclear Explosion
core: A mushroom cloud standing for a tiny action that causes total destruction or an overwhelming reaction.
avoid: Not for real-world wars or disasters.

name: Robotnik Pressing Red Button
core: Two buttons and Robotnik gleefully slams the red one: picking the chaotic or bad option with enthusiasm.
avoid: Not for agonising over a choice; he picks instantly and happily.

name: Overly Manly Man
core: A Victorian boxer who does everything in the most absurdly manly way possible.
avoid: Not for weakness or failure.

name: That Sign Won't Stop Me Because I Can't Read
core: DW ignores a warning sign because she can't read it: blissfully ignoring a rule or warning out of ignorance.
avoid: Not for rules someone consciously defies; the point is obliviousness.

name: Skyrim Skill
core: A maxed-out Skyrim skill at level 100, used to brag about being an expert at some petty or useless thing.
avoid: Not for actual impressive achievements; it's for silly expertise.

name: Deadpool Surprised
core: Deadpool clutching his masked face in mock shock, a theatrical gasp at something scandalous or unexpected.
avoid: Not for genuine tragedy; the shock is playful.

name: Actual Advice Mallard
core: A mallard giving genuinely useful, sincere life advice, the helpful opposite of Malicious Advice Mallard.
avoid: Not for sarcastic or harmful advice.

name: Girl Running
core: A little girl in a yellow raincoat sprinting with wide eyes, used for eagerly rushing toward (or away from) something.
avoid: Not for calm or slow situations.

name: Ben Affleck Smoking
core: A worn-out Ben Affleck exhaling a cigarette, eyes closed: exhausted defeat after something draining.
avoid: Not for happy or energetic moments.

name: Dabbing Dude
core: Chaos erupts on one side while a guy calmly hits his vape on the other: staying unbothered while everything falls apart.
avoid: Not for situations where the bystander is actually helping.

name: Frustrated Boromir
core: Boromir rubbing his forehead in exasperation at something tiresome or stupid.
avoid: Not to be confused with One Does Not Simply; this one is pure exasperation.

name: Mom Can We Have
core: Asking for the real thing and getting told there's one at home, then revealing the sad knockoff version you actually get.
avoid: Not for cases where the home version is as good or better.

name: Welcome To The Internets
core: A cat with a gun riding a laser-eyed unicorn past rainbows and explosions: something absurdly epic or chaotic.
avoid: Not for mundane or understated moments.

name: Elmo Fire
core: Elmo raising his arms in front of hellfire, embracing pure chaos or unhinged rage.
avoid: Not for calm or wholesome moments.

name: Trojan Horse
core: A harmless-looking gift being welcomed in while soldiers hide inside: something appealing that smuggles in a nasty surprise.
avoid: Not for things that are openly bad; the danger must be hidden.

name: Virgin Vs Chad
core: A slouching, insecure 'virgin' strides beside a confident 'Chad', contrasting the timid way and the bold way of doing something.
avoid: Not for neutral comparisons; one side must be the cringe, the other the confident one.

name: Inspirational Quote
core: A serene sunset backdrop for a fake inspirational quote that is actually mundane, cynical or absurd.
avoid: Not for sincerely inspirational quotes.

name: Disappearing
core: A guy slowly fades out of frame, used for quietly vanishing to avoid an awkward situation.
avoid: Not for confronting a situation head on.

name: Evil Plotting Raccoon
core: A raccoon rubbing its paws together while hatching a sneaky, petty evil plan.
avoid: Not for innocent or kind actions.

name: Yoda
core: Yoda dispensing wisdom, captioned with advice phrased in his backwards sentence structure.
avoid: Not for captions in normal word order; the joke is Yoda-speak.

name: Por Que Tan Elegante Homero
core: Bart asks Homer why he's dressed so fancy, and Homer gives an absurdly trivial reason for celebrating.
avoid: Not for genuinely big occasions; the reason should be petty.

name: No Patrick
core: Patrick raising his hand to ask a hilariously dumb or literal question, as in 'Is mayonnaise an instrument?'
avoid: Not for smart or reasonable questions.

name: Blank Protest Sign
core: A big blank sign held up at a protest, filled with a passionate demand about something petty.
avoid: Not for mocking real tragedies or real protest causes.

name: Happy Then Shocked
core: A man grinning, then his smile collapsing into dismay as he learns the catch.
avoid: Not for news that stays good.

name: Orangutan Chasing Girl On A Tricycle
core: An orangutan pedalling a tiny tricycle after a screaming girl: something relentless chasing you down.
avoid: Not for things you're happy to see coming.
